context: func loadCachedValue(for key: String) -> Value?
text: Return a cached value only while its source and configuration are unchanged. Expired entries are removed before the next lookup so they cannot hide a newer result.

context: func cancelPendingRequests()
text: Cancel the previous request before starting another one. A late result must be discarded even if it contains the same text, because the focused field may have changed.

context: Issue: List loses selection after closing another window
text: Open two windows and select the second item in the first list. Close the other window, then return to the list. The selection should remain on the same item.

context: Review summary for a small settings change
text: This keeps the user's chosen window size when switching sections and restores the last selected pane when Settings opens again. The keyboard shortcut and existing controls are preserved.
